title: Span workspace run configurations
description: Explicit non-interactive commands. Reading this file never executes a command. This project file is plaintext; use environment references for credentials.

id.description: Stable identifier generated by Span. Detected tasks must be duplicated before editing.

executable.description: Executable name or full path. Span does not insert a shell.

args.description: Exact argument boundaries, including spaces. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${env:NAME}.

cwd.description: Existing directory inside the workspace, relative to its root or using ${workspaceFolder}.

env.description: Explicit child environment overrides. Use ${env:NAME} instead of saving credential values. Inherited environment values are not copied into this file.
